<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{min_batt}" />
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
  <Sequence>
    <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{nav_speed}" timeout_s="60" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    <ReturnToLaunch timeout_s="120" velocity="{nav_speed}" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    <Land timeout_s="60" />
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="min_batt" min="10" max="24" initial="15" /><port name="nav_speed" min="2" max="8" initial="5" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Wrap 'guarded_flight' in a Fallback. In the nominal case, the original subtree executes and completes all goals. If the battery drops below 25%, the original subtree fails and the fallback branch takes over. The fallback branch uses a lower battery threshold, completes any remaining required goals using GoToRequiredGoal, and then safely returns to launch and lands, abandoning optional goals to ensure mission success and vehicle safety.</rationale></patch>
